title: Printing Papers
description:
'ouv'e done well ta get this far. The world of smithing is just opening up to you. We got a tool and a repair kit, but before we go any ferther, I think it's time 'e getcha some proper blueprints.
I 'aid this earlier on, I think, but blueprints act the same as templates, only they can be used multiple times, unlike templates, which are one use only.
To make bluepprints, you'll firs' need to make [blueprint paper](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/blueprint_paper.png:124:62). After that, is just like making templates wit' the boards. For the most part you'll be makin' a tool with the paper in place of the material.
